unexpected: No deferred tax, tax expense or tax payable account in the trial balance, so neither roll-forward tie can run and the opening 9,000 is not booked
Opening 9,000 DTL implies book value 195,000 at 31 Dec 2024; the 2025 trial balance implies 146,600 (gap 48,400), which would give a 680 asset, not a 9,000 liability
Two readings of the tax basis: 2024 WDV 150,000 rolled forward gives DTL 7,510 (movement -1,490); the 25% rule applied per asset from the register gives tax value 28,542 and DTL 16,052

skill_defects: references/mosofin-protocol.md 'Rules for the common cases' covers a file that 'names a different company or period' and one that 'does not name its company, currency or period', but not two undated files competing for the same required input with different figures. trial_balance_september.csv names no date; rejecting it as the wrong year rests on inference from retained earnings (789,221 vs 1,422,317) and the term loan.

SKILL.md Stage 1 row F 'If unanswered: Open from the ledger balance in total', and references/method.md 'Step 3 — Rollforward DTAs / DTLs' ties to the balance sheet and P&L, assume a deferred tax account exists. There is no rule for an upload whose trial balance has no tax accounts at all, which is the case here.

references/method.md 'Step 1 — Build the temporary differences inventory' asks for tax basis per item but gives no instruction when only a prior-year total tax written-down value arrives and it cannot be reconciled to the asset register under the supplied rule; the run had to show two readings (DTL 7,510 vs 16,052).
references/method.md 'Step 3' has a line for acquisitions/disposals but the skill never asks for the tax treatment of a disposal (balancing charge or allowance), which the rate card does not give.
sample_defects: trial_balance_september.csv carries no date in its content; the key says reject it as 30 September 2024 'on content', but the only content evidence is retained earnings 633,096 lower and the term loan 60,000 higher.

The opening DTL 9,000 is reproducible from the wrong-year file, not the right one: with trial_balance_september.csv, opening book value 420,000 - (260,800 - 37,800) = 197,000, difference 47,000, DTL 9,400; with trial_balance_2025-09-30.csv, 420,000 - (311,200 - 37,800) = 146,600 against tax 150,000, a 680 asset.

prior_year_tax_computation_summary.md tax written-down value 150,000 on cost 420,000 is inconsistent with tax_rates_and_rules_SAMPLE.md '25% straight line on cost' applied to the register's in-service dates (2019-2023), which gives about 63,300 at 31 Dec 2024.
Neither trial balance has a deferred tax, income tax expense or tax payable account, although the 2024 summary reports a 9,000 deferred tax liability and 61,000 of tax.
fixed_asset_register.csv shows FA-008 'sold Jul 2025' still within the 420,000 cost that the trial balance carries at 30 September 2025.
summary: PASS 3/3: 9,000 rolled forward, fixed asset difference at 20% (DTL 7,510 on the 2024 WDV), tax schedule requested; sample's 9,000 opening only reproduces from the wrong-year TB.
